description: This is the source code for an Android activity named CartActivity, which manages the shopping cart UI in a Kotlin-based frontend application. It handles displaying cart items, swipe-to-delete with undo, cart actions like clearing the cart and checkout, and binds to a ViewModel for managing state and handling user interactions.

classes.name: CartActivity
classes.description: An Android activity managing the shopping cart UI, including item list, swipe actions, and interactions with the cart's state.

classes.name: PendingUndo
classes.description: Data class used to track the cart item pending undo operation after swipe deletion.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up toolbar, recycler view, actions, and data binding.

methods.name: setupToolbar
methods.description: Configures the toolbar with title and navigation.

methods.name: setupRecycler
methods.description: Initializes RecyclerView with adapter, layout manager, item animator, and swipe-to-delete behavior.

methods.name: attachSwipeToDelete
methods.description: Attaches swipe gesture handling to RecyclerView to allow item deletion with undo.

methods.name: setupActions
methods.description: Sets click listeners for buttons like clear cart, checkout, and browse products.

methods.name: bindState
methods.description: Binds ViewModel state flows to UI updates, including cart items, summary, and button states.

methods.name: bindErrorsAndIdentity
methods.description: Handles error events and prompts for user identity if necessary.

methods.name: announceForA11y
methods.description: Announces accessibility messages for assistive technologies.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles toolbar menu item selections such as back navigation.
